svg.title: Placeholder artwork for Greenville County Election Certification: a typographic plate, not a photograph
svg.desc: A warm paper plate carrying the event name "Greenville County Election Certification" and the date 6 NOVEMBER 2026, 11:00 AM. It stands in for artwork that does not exist yet and must be replaced with a real photograph.
